title: Privacy
lead: Your swing belongs to you. This app has no server and collects no data.
account.title: No account
account.body: There is nothing to sign up for or log in to. The app does not know who you are.
network.title: No network after install
network.body: The app downloads itself the first time you open it. After that, practice, analysis and results all happen on the phone, and the app makes no network requests.
local.title: Your data stays on this phone
local.body: Videos, poses, results, venues and settings are kept in this browser's storage on this phone, and nowhere else.
third.title: Shared with no one
third.body: Neither we nor any third party receive your data. There are no ads, analytics or trackers.
sensors.title: Camera, microphone and motion
sensors.body: Used only while you practise: the camera films the swing, the microphone hears the strike, and motion sensing helps you level the phone. If you refuse one, everything else still works.
backup.title: Backups are up to you
backup.body: History can save your data as one file, wherever you choose. The app never uploads or shares anything on its own.
eviction.title: iPhone may delete website data
eviction.body: If the app is not opened for a while, iPhone may delete website data. Add the app to your Home Screen, turn on protection under Storage, and back up regularly.
delete.title: Delete all data
delete.body: Deletes every video, result, venue, setting and record this app keeps on this phone. The app itself stays, so you can start again.
delete.confirm.title: Delete all data?
delete.confirm.body: All videos, every swing's results, venues and settings will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. Back up in History first if you need them.
delete.failed: Some data could not be deleted. Reload the app and try again.
